title: Unable to take screenshots on Steam

posts.author: GoldSmeargle
posts.body: Hello everyone! My game is now available on Steam and it runs great, with one exception: there's no way to take a screenshot. Even after changing the default key to another (since F12 resets the game) and enabling the overlay, it still won't capture. I read it's a common issue but I still haven't found any solutions. Do you know a safe/proper way to resolve this issue?

posts.author: Chiispiitas
posts.body:
Steam screenshots only work when the Steam Overlay is actually active, and VX Ace has long had issues with overlay support... Even VX Ace games on Steam like LISA: The Painful and Skyborn don't really support screenshots.
The only real workaround is to use Print Screen / Win+Shift+S, or add your own in-game screenshot function via scripting.
